```sql
WITH non_skipped AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        checked_at,
        status,
        MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN checked_at END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY service
            ORDER BY checked_at
            ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS recovery_at,
        MAX(checked_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY service
        ) AS last_checked_at
    FROM checks
    WHERE status <> 'skipped'
),
runs AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        MIN(checked_at) AS started_at,
        recovery_at AS ended_at,
        COUNT(*) AS failed_checks,
        MAX(last_checked_at) AS last_checked_at
    FROM non_skipped
    WHERE status IN ('fail', 'timeout')
    GROUP BY service, recovery_at
),
previous_runs AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(ended_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY service
            ORDER BY started_at
        ) AS previous_recovery_at
    FROM runs
),
numbered_runs AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN previous_recovery_at IS NULL
                     OR started_at - previous_recovery_at >= 10
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY service
            ORDER BY started_at
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS episode_id
    FROM previous_runs
),
episodes AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        MIN(started_at) AS started_at,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(ended_at) < COUNT(*) THEN NULL
            ELSE MAX(ended_at)
        END AS ended_at,
        SUM(failed_checks) AS failed_checks,
        MAX(last_checked_at) AS last_checked_at
    FROM numbered_runs
    GROUP BY service, episode_id
),
measured_episodes AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        started_at,
        ended_at,
        COALESCE(ended_at, last_checked_at) - started_at AS duration_min,
        failed_checks
    FROM episodes
)
SELECT
    service,
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    duration_min,
    failed_checks,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY service
        ORDER BY duration_min DESC, started_at ASC
    ) AS severity_rank
FROM measured_episodes
WHERE ended_at IS NULL OR duration_min >= 15
ORDER BY service, started_at;
```
